x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

closest_num = 0.0
closest_den = 1.0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    ratio = x / y
    floor_part = int((ratio * i) // 1)
    ceil_part = int(-(-ratio * i // 1))  # equivalent to ceil for positive numbers

    if abs(ratio - floor_part / i) < abs(ratio - closest_num / closest_den):
        closest_num = floor_part
        closest_den = i
    if abs(ratio - ceil_part / i) < abs(ratio - closest_num / closest_den):
        closest_num = ceil_part
        closest_den = i

print(f"{int(closest_num)}/{int(closest_den)}")
</translated_code>
